lede: Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro is the talk of the week, Alphabet shares fell almost 13% after its results, and Cyclone Arnab has forced more than 55,000 people out of their homes in Odisha. Fresh Singapore AI startup news was thin today, so that section has two stories instead of five.
stocks_note: Latest closes: New York, Thursday 29 October (AAPL, GOOGL) and SGX, Thursday 29 October (DBS), via Yahoo Finance. Alphabet's drop followed its third-quarter results on 28 October.

sections.title: Apple
sections.subtitle: Official news in brief, then 9to5Mac and MacRumors

official.label: From Apple
official.summary: Apple used the past few days to launch a touchscreen MacBook Pro with its new PROLED XDR display, plus a 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 and an M6 iMac. It also gave the iPad mini what it calls its biggest update ever, added new AI features to Creator Studio, and brought Siri AI to more languages.

items.headline: Apple hardware chief explains why the new iPad mini skips 120Hz
items.summary: Apple's VP of Hardware Engineering, Dave Pakula, gave two interviews about the redesigned iPad mini. He covered the OLED screen that stays at 60Hz instead of ProMotion, and the new Acoustic Display, in a thinner and lighter body.

items.headline: TrendForce sees up to 1.5 million OLED MacBook Pros shipping in 2027
items.summary: A new TrendForce report looks at what Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro means for the OLED notebook market. It estimates Apple could ship as many as 1.5 million of the machines in 2027.

items.headline: Xcode 27.2 reveals RAM in the new Apple TV 4K and iPad mini
items.summary: Apple's Xcode 27.2 release gives away how much memory sits in two new devices. The fourth-generation Apple TV 4K with an A19 chip carries 8GB, and the OLED iPad mini's amount is listed alongside it.

items.headline: Apple cuts its Taiwan App Store commission to 26 percent
items.summary: From 31 October, Apple will charge 26 percent instead of 30 on in-app purchases and paid apps on the Taiwan iOS and iPadOS storefront. The change follows talks with the country's regulators.

items.headline: Laos power import plan would bring in 500MW of renewable electricity
items.summary: A proposal to import 500 megawatts of renewable electricity from Laos into Singapore was signed on the sidelines of Singapore International Energy Week, as the country looks to widen its energy sources.

items.headline: SIA keeps Dubai flights off the schedule until February 2027
items.summary: Singapore Airlines has extended its cancellations of flights to and from Dubai, which now run through 28 February 2027.

items.headline: New SGH emergency and neuroscience building speeds up stroke care
items.summary: The new Singapore General Hospital emergency and National Neuroscience Institute building has cut stroke treatment times, with workflows redesigned around the patient rather than the department.

items.headline: MSF counts about 6,700 new child abuse cases in 2025
items.summary: Singapore recorded around 6,700 new child abuse cases last year, according to the Ministry of Social and Family Development's domestic violence trends report, and the figure remains elevated.

items.headline: Haze work with Indonesia is only just beginning
items.summary: Skies over Singapore are clearing, but Singapore and Indonesia say the longer job of tackling the haze at its source has barely started.

items.headline: Cyclone Arnab forces over 55,000 out of their homes in Odisha
items.summary: The very severe cyclone has hit Odisha, with more than 55,000 people moved from nine districts. Andhra Pradesh's chief minister puts the damage there at no less than ₹4,600 crore.

items.headline: Telangana sends 2,000 staff to restore Andhra Pradesh power
items.summary: Telangana's two power utilities have dispatched nearly 2,000 workers and emergency material to Andhra Pradesh to restore supply after the cyclone.

items.headline: Bhutan glacial lake burst triggers flood alert in Assam and Bengal
items.summary: Flash floods in the upper reaches of the Sankosh river have prompted an advisory, since water levels could rise suddenly in Dhubri in Assam and Alipurduar in West Bengal.

items.headline: Rahul Gandhi questions IDBI Bank stake sale to Fairfax
items.summary: The Congress leader said he stands with the bank's employees as he challenged the Centre's decision to sell its IDBI Bank stake to Fairfax.

items.headline: Ten overground workers arrested in a Shopian terror financing case
items.summary: Police in Jammu and Kashmir's Shopian district arrested ten overground workers in a case about funding for militants.

items.headline: Netanyahu's bloc falls short of a majority and Likud alleges fraud
items.summary: Israel's opposition accuses the prime minister of trying to undermine the election after his coalition lost its majority. Likud claims foreign interference and says Arab-led parties stole the vote.

items.headline: Russian drone strike on Dnipro train station kills at least 14
items.summary: Officials say at least 14 people died and as many were wounded, including an 11-year-old boy, when a Russian drone hit a station in the central Ukrainian city.

items.headline: Leaked audio shows Spanish rail exchanges before deadly crash
items.summary: Recordings appear to show one high-speed train was cleared to travel at normal speed even though another ahead had stalled.

items.headline: Xi stresses party discipline as purges hit a record
items.summary: At a major Chinese political gathering, Xi Jinping pressed for discipline while the number of officials purged reached a record. Observers say the campaign helps consolidate his authority.

items.headline: Machado returns to Venezuela and urges elections in 2027
items.summary: The Nobel-winning opposition figure came back from exile, praised Trump for 'freedom' and criticised a controversial US oil deal with Caracas.

brief.summary: NTU and Google signed a pact to expand AI in teaching and research, with undergraduates already using Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI since August. Separately, Nvidia says Singapore-based Megaspeed's chip dealings were normal after a probe report, while Entire now offers code hosting with data kept in Singapore.

sections.title: Singapore AI startups
sections.subtitle: Funding, hiring, and what they're building

items.headline: Entire launches Git code hosting with data kept in Singapore
items.summary: The GitHub rival now lets teams store repository data in Singapore, a draw for companies with data-residency needs.

items.headline: Nvidia defends its dealings with Singapore AI cloud firm Megaspeed
items.summary: Jensen Huang said Nvidia reviewed Megaspeed's GPU deployments and found no illegal diversion of AI chips to China, after a report on a probe. A separate New York Times report says a top Megaspeed executive may have been a Chinese spy.

items.headline: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings agrees to buy ADT
items.summary: Thrive Holdings is buying the home security company for $10 a share, a $15.3 billion deal including debt, and plans to bring AI to the business.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with a focus on cybersecurity
items.summary: Google's newest frontier model claims significant gains in coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO filing sets out a compute-first business plan
items.summary: Analysts reading the S-1 say it justifies spending as much as possible on compute, and Wall Street is being asked to buy into the AGI story.

items.headline: Jassy says AWS can reach $1 trillion, but spending comes first
items.summary: Amazon's CEO said AWS could become the first $1 trillion revenue business, while capital spending on AI cloud capacity keeps climbing.

items.headline: Gemini can now generate and edit documents inside chats
items.summary: Google's assistant can create, preview and edit PDFs, Docs, Sheets, slide decks, Markdown, text files and code within a conversation.

items.headline: Iluvatar CoreX says its Tiangai 300 GPU matches Nvidia's H200
items.summary: The Chinese chipmaker claims its new GPU matches and even surpasses the H200 on real workloads, a sign of the domestic push to close the gap.

items.headline: Tencent makes Southeast Asia the launch pad for its WorkBuddy agent
items.summary: Facing fierce competition at home, Tencent is taking its low-cost workplace AI assistant abroad, starting with Southeast Asia.

items.headline: Huawei's Tau Scaling Law reaches its base stations
items.summary: Huawei is already putting elements of the chip design principle into its wireless network, as it works around US export controls.

items.headline: Unitree's quarterly revenue jumps 70 percent
items.summary: The robotics maker reported 665 million yuan, up 69.93 percent, but profit excluding one-offs fell 17.42 percent as AI spending rose.

items.headline: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter cyber model
items.summary: The French lab says an open-weight model gives organisations control over their cyber defences that closed models cannot.
